title: LJS 51 f. 22v.9: shape-class re-transcription and frozen held-out key test (contribution)

documents.shelfmark: University of Pennsylvania, Kislak Center, LJS 51, f. 22v l.9-13, f. 23r l.1 (Penn IIIF canvases 50-51)

transcription.notes: Two blind shape-class transcriptions (A 81 signs/25 classes, B 80/22), strict agreement 74/81, arbitrated to 81 signs / 22 classes; arbiter not blind to the plaintext.

solution.what: Frozen held-out test (MANIFEST_v1 3541c57c..., hash on #1023 before measuring): key learned on signs 1-40 by gapped hard-EM alignment, decoded on 41-81: 0.692 characters vs best of 200 shuffled controls 0.359 (mean 0.231); declared inverse 0.488 vs 0.350. Criterion 0.85 and +0.30 not met.

Exploratory, after the measurement, not validated: shape class S1 falls on every hamza (أثبتك, أعتذر, الشآم and both first words, where the compiler has ل); ذلك enciphered twice as ذالك (extra alif) - candidate for the compiler's 'he erred in it'.
